title: Local-to-global gluing of an injective change-of-variables formula over a countable open cover (parent steps 5, 6, 8)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P, let N ⊆ ℝ^P, let Φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be continuous and injective, and let w : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]. Assume every y ∈ N has an open neighbourhood W ⊆ ℝ^P with the following property: ∫⁻_{Φ(B)} g dμ = ∫⁻_B w(x)·g(Φ(x)) dμ(x) for every Borel set B ⊆ W ∩ N and every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]. Then ∫⁻_{Φ(B)} g dμ = ∫⁻_B w(x)·g(Φ(x)) dμ(x) for every Borel set B ⊆ N and every g : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]. The integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals; no measurability of g or w is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), Continuous Φ → Injective Φ → (∀ y ∈ N, ∃ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclid P), B ⊆ W ∩ N → MeasurableSet B → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ z in Φ '' B, g z ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in B, w x * g (Φ x) ∂μ) → ∀ B : Set (Euclid P), B ⊆ N → MeasurableSet B → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ z in Φ '' B, g z ∂μ = ∫⁻ x in B, w x * g (Φ x) ∂μ
